descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S18 Live Ask AI in Hospital: the call's log row splits vendor time from the total and names the model

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U13 Every AI call (pre-round summary, note generation, billing, Ask AI, photo capture, handoff) logs its total time and, separately, the time the AI provider itself took, and which model answered (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9; TFA-94514 AC 7)
  • U15 Usage analytics rows carry no patient content (no name, MRN, room, diagnosis, task text or note text), so rows that outlive a deleted patient do not break the 36 h retention claim or TC-24's hard del … (UAT 3.6; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Local stack with the same AI settings as dev; fresh ask-ai account; Hospital patient with two medications

When Ask 'What medications is the patient on?'

Then The assist.askChart aiCallLog row has providerMs > 0 and <= durationMs, model set, no fellBackFrom on this normal path; the matching ai_disclosure audit row has the same provider_ms; the answer names both medications. A total over 30 s is recorded for review with Vikram where the AI service was not the cause (3.5: a target, not pass/fail). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.5 'logs how long the AI call itself took, separately from the total' + TFA-94514 AC 7 + 3.9 model recorded. Decided by the providerSplit check (R7), which does not exist yet; the answer checks are a sanity check, not a 3.2 AI Check, and cannot pass U13 on their own. U15: serialised rows mustNotContain 'QA Hosp OAT06 Timing', 'Furosemide', 'Lisinopril'. …

Where it ran: dev unit U28; test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: AI check (blocked)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
